name: Awesome Blocks
author: Abdullah Nahian

sections.description:
Awesome Blocks Inline is a professional WordPress plugin that provides multiple custom Gutenberg blocks:

  • CTA Block – Create engaging call-to-action sections with heading, description, and button.
  • Team Block – Showcase team members with photo, name, and role.
  • Blog Block – Display latest blog posts with configurable post count.
  • Testimonial Block – Display testimonials with author name and content.
  • Price Block – Show pricing plans with name, price, and features.

All blocks are grouped under a custom Gutenberg category called “Awesome Blocks” for easy access. This plugin is lightweight, translation-ready, and works with the latest WordPress versions.

Arbitrary section

This plugin is fully GPL and free to use, modify, and distribute. Perfect for agencies, developers, and designers to build custom websites quickly.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the awesome-blocks folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open the Gutenberg editor and you’ll find the blocks under the Awesome Blocks category.
sections.faq:
Can I use these blocks in any theme?

Yes! The blocks are compatible with any WordPress theme that supports Gutenberg.

Are the blocks responsive?

Yes! All blocks are designed to be mobile-friendly and responsive.

Can I customize the styles?

Yes! You can override styles by enqueuing your own CSS or using the WordPress customizer.
